fields.acceptance: A test in internal/tui builds the roadmap app over fake roadmap and ready results and asserts the view has the group headings, a row per change set with state, title and not-ready reasons, and no JSON braces; that j moves the cursor to the next change set row, skipping headings; and the --once test in cmd/rhiza/testdata/script still compares equal to rhiza roadmap --json
fields.statement: The roadmap app shows the roadmap as a cursor list, not JSON: a heading per milestone group and the backlog, one row per change set with its short ID, state, title, and the reasons it is not ready; j/k or the arrows move the cursor, r reloads, q quits, and rhiza tui app roadmap --once still prints what rhiza roadmap --json prints

fields.acceptance: A test builds the app over fake change.show, ready and run results, presses enter on a change set row and asserts the detail lists its intent, each leaf's statement and acceptance, each blocking question's statement and the latest run's state and step; esc returns to the list with the same row selected
fields.statement: Enter on a change set in the roadmap app opens its detail: intent, kind and state, its leaves each with statement and acceptance, the open questions that block it, and its latest run with the run's state and current step; esc goes back to the list with the cursor where it was

fields.acceptance: A test with a fake exec presses p then y on a ready change set and asserts one rex window new call whose command is rhiza run start <cs> --workflow plan with no --autonomous; s then y gives rhiza run start <cs> --autonomous --permission-mode auto; n calls nothing; o on a change set with a live run calls rex to focus that run's tab, and on one without says no live run; no test runs real Rex
fields.statement: On the selected change set, p starts a plan run and s starts a ship run, each in a new Rex tab running rhiza run start, the plan run interactive and the ship run autonomous with permission mode auto; the app asks y/n first, stays open, and says which tab it opened; o focuses the Rex tab of the change set's live run, or says there is none

fields.acceptance: A test over a temporary repository with a proposed change set presses a, sees the what-if, presses y and asserts the change set is accepted; another with a change set blocked by a question opens its detail, picks the question, types an answer and enter, and asserts a Decision quoting the typed text answers the question, rhiza ready reports the change set ready, and rhiza check passes
fields.statement: On the selected change set, a accepts a proposed one after showing the accept what-if and a y/n; in the detail, choosing a blocking question and typing an answer records a Decision with the owner's typed words as its quote, linked answers to the question, in that change set, so the change set becomes ready; the list reloads after either
